edit.description: Registration gains the settings-selection channel; lock grammar parses it
channel_load_moment: the channel loads at launch where a settings file selects the style
reach handles the new channel; an output style's reach unchanged
explain narrates the selected style's load moment from the one fact
outputStyle registers the channel, cited; doc comment no longer says channel-less
guard binds on a selected output style
reach and explain over the channel

summary: The active output style loads at launch where a settings file selects it: a load channel for output-style
acceptance: a loads("launch") guard judges an output style a committed settings file selects
tests: a loads launch guard binds its body on an output style a settings file selects
a loads guard is silent on an output style no settings file selects
explain narrates a selected output style as loading at launch
pins: an output style no settings file selects is not reported unreachable
notes: Selection reads the settings/settings-local `outputStyle` edge (sdk/src/builtins.ts). Channel name is build's call. Shares gate.rs/read.rs/load_moment_guard.rs with LOAD-CHANNEL-SUPPORTING-DOC. .temper/lock.toml is outside the fence; it carries no output-style row today.
